title: Breaking Things (in a good way)
description:
There are 2 break tags in html: `br` and `hr`. These are a type of tag that _doesn't need a closing tag_. This is called a _void element_. - `
`: * Forces text on a new line (kinda like if it were a block element) * Does _not_ create a new paragraph * Should be used _very sparingly_, EG in Addresses/Poetry/Music. - `
` * Creates a horizontal line * Means "This part of the content is over" * Not decoration, thematic breaks. You probably will see one before the `assignment` section of this lesson. **Important**: `br` IS NOT FOR CREATING SPACING EVERYWHERE. It is not for layout spacing, it is when it is core to the layout. HTML is for the layout, CSS is for stylizing it. --- ## Assignment: (look a hr ^) Make our 500 page nicer! Add a line between the main warning and the description
